page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-standard-32 is a general-purpose server instance powered by an x86_64 AMD EPYC 9B45 processor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 16 physical cores with 2 threads per core, supported by 124 GB of RAM, which equates to approximately 3.88 GB of memory per core. The CPU architecture includes an L1d cache of 48 KB, an L2 cache of 1.0 MB, and an L3 cache of 32 MB. It includes advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512, AVX-512 VNNI, and AVX-512 BF16, alongside cryptography acceleration via AES and SHA_NI. This instance does not include local storage or bundled GPUs.

In benchmark testing, the c4d-standard-32 demonstrates top-tier single-core CPU performance, ranking in the top 10% for stress-ng single-core, Geekbench single-core, and single-threaded gzip compression. Multi-core performance is also strong, with Geekbench multi-core scores in the top 10% and PassMark CPU scores in the top 25%. Memory bandwidth and database operations, such as Redis SET operations, perform in the average tier. For machine learning workloads, the instance achieves top-tier text generation speeds with small LLM models of 135M parameters and average speeds with medium models of 7B parameters.

The hardware profile offers a balanced resource density, providing high-performance dedicated compute cores without the added cost of bundled local NVMe storage or GPU accelerators. This makes it a cost-efficient choice for workloads that require strong single-threaded performance and modern vector instructions but do not require local disk persistence. Appropriate workloads include software compilation, text and image processing, static web serving, and lightweight LLM inference.
